title: Harness settings hygiene: timeouts, existing scripts, no denied tools in matchers, read-only agents without shell, fail-open made visible
body:
Why: Fable audit 1114f (.krn/runs/overnight/fable-audit-1114f.md) fixes 6, 8, 9, 10: settings.json:48,86,90,94 no timeout; Workflow denied but in matcher (:8,:121); krn-radar has Bash on untrusted feeds; allow Bash(python3 -); gauge.ts:323 catches all and silently drops the ceiling; guards return on unparsable JSON; stale grant text (krn review) and memory links to missing files; ~700 tokens of unused skills.
Outcome: test/rules/settings-hygiene.test.ts enforces these; gauge failure emits one advisory line; memory-refs fails on links to missing files; unused skills off in project settings.
Proof: the hygiene test is red today and green after; gauge test with invalid window emits one advisory.
